# Ask for a description when a task has none

When a playbook files a task, or changes one, give the task ten minutes first.
A change that finishes or cancels a task needs nothing.

If the task is marked urgent, give it one minute instead.

Then look at the task again. If it has a description by then, there is
nothing to do. If the task is gone, or cannot be read, there is nothing to do
either.

If it still has no description, send me this message: "This task has had
no description for ten minutes. Please add one, so that it can be worked
on."
